searched: Retrieved 2026-10-29, sequentially and directly (no relay, no archive). CAC: the announcement page of 2 April 2024 (cac.gov.cn/2024-04/02/c_1713729983803145.htm), which on retrieval listed 13 attachments (附件1 生成式人工智能服务已备案信息（2024年4月） to 附件13 …（2026年8月）); all 13 PDFs were fetched through the page's downloadfile.jsp links (one connection reset on 附件5, retried successfully) and their rows were counted from pdftotext layout output; five listings are proposed as documents (2024-04, 2024-08, 2025-01, 2025-08, 2026-08: the opening list, the earliest with a registered section, the one reaching the stated end-2024 total, the earliest with a BAAI entry, and the latest). Cross-checks: the filed numbering reaches 302 in the January 2025 list and 748 in the December 2025 list, and the registered numbering 105 and 435, matching the totals the CAC states for 31 December 2024 and 31 December 2025. The CAC's announcement of 9 January 2026 on 2025 filings (cac.gov.cn/2026-01/09/c_1769688009588554.htm) was retrieved after two connection resets. Deep-synthesis algorithm filings: the CAC announcements of 20 June 2023 (first) and 17 July 2026 (eighteenth batch, the latest located) and their attachments, which are .docx files; the pack tool stores no text layer for them, so their counts were made from word/document.xml and are carried as paraphrase on the announcement pages. Batches 2 to 17 were not retrieved (bounded). Covered developers were searched in all 13 generative-AI attachments by name: StepFun, 01.AI, iFlytek, SenseTime, Tencent and Shanghai AI Laboratory appear in the April 2024 list, BAAI (北京智源人工智能研究院) earliest in the August 2025 list; of the earlier collections' developers, Zhipu, MiniMax and Baidu (April 2024) and DeepSeek (August 2024) were recorded because the dataset already holds their listed legal names; Moonshot AI (北京月之暗面科技有限公司, April 2024 list, row 16), ByteDance (北京抖音信息服务有限公司, 云雀大模型, row 3) and Alibaba (阿里巴巴达摩院（杭州）科技有限公司, row 11) appear but were left out because no dataset record or brief mapping ties those legal names to the dataset entities. Latest-listing entries per developer were not drafted (budget). In the first deep-synthesis list iFlytek (科大讯飞股份有限公司), Tencent (深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司), Zhipu and Baidu entities appear; not drafted. Provincial lists of locally filed services and the CAC algorithm-filing system (beian.cac.gov.cn) were not searched. TC260: the three framework editions were fetched again from the URLs of the dataset sources (SHA-256 identical to the dataset's records) and searched for provisions not yet recorded, especially on developers and open-source models; the CAC news item for 2.0 (cac.gov.cn/2025-09/15/c_1759653448369123.htm) and TC260's news item for 3.0 were read for replacement wording: neither news item says an edition replaces another; the 2.0 and 3.0 prefaces say each was drafted on the basis of the earlier editions and updates them, recorded as two supersedes_document candidates for reviewer decision. No retrieval was refused (no HTTP 4xx/5xx); cac.gov.cn reset first connections several times (curl error 35), each retried successfully. Web search was used for discovery of the 2026 and deep-synthesis announcement URLs only.
